text: The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය

LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My No.: AKU/LAN/06/LA/66. Land Ministry's Ref. No.: 4-3/24/2020/HA/88. I do hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose: Description of the land or servitude to be acquired: The allotment of land described below depicted in sheet, No. 02 of block 02 of Surveyor General's Cadastral Map No. 820493 situated at the Village of Lenama in Grama Niladhari Division of Lenama South in Weligam Korale North, Divisional Secretary’s Division of Akuressa in the District of Matara in the Southern Province. Lot No. 1 - Name of the Land: Kirimatithudallewatta - Extent: 0.0341 Hectare. North: Lot No. 194A of F.V.P. 535; East: Lot No. 194A of F.V.P. 535; South: Lot No. 194A of F.V.P. 535; West: Lot No. 194A of F.V.P. 535.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at Divisional Secretariat Akuressa on the 02nd day of April 2025 at 9.30 a.m. As well, It is hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 26th day of March 2025 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. K. G. D. Aඇඈඃൺ, Divisional Secretary, Akuressa. Divisional Secretariat, Akuressa. 24th February, 2025. EOG 02 - 0287

LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT) No. 28 OF 1964 Notice under Section 7 My No.: AKU/LAN/06/LA83. Land Ministry's Ref. No.: 4-3/5/2018/HA/301. I do hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose: Description of the land or servitude to be acquired: The allotment of land described below depicted in sheet, No. 02 of block 02 of Surveyor General's Cadastral Map No. 820522 situated at the Village of Gallala in the Grama Niladhari Division of Gallala in Weligam Korale North, Divisional Secretary’s Division of Akuressa in the District of Matara in the Southern Province. Lot No. 1 - Name of the Land: Pahalawatta and Udawatta - Extent: 0.0253 Hectare. North: Lot No. 95A of F.V.P. 555; East: Lot No. 95A of F.V.P. 555; South: Lot No. 95A of F.V.P. 555; West: Lot No. 95A of F.V.P. 555.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at Divisional Secretariat Akuressa on the 09th day of April 2025 at 9.30 a.m. As well, It is hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 02nd day of April 2025 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. K. G. D. Aඇඈඃൺ, Divisional Secretary, Akuressa. Divisional Secretariat, Akuressa. 24th February, 2025. EOG 02 - 0288
